title: Quadrijugous
summary: QUADRIJU'GOUS, adjective [Latin quadra and jugum, yoke.] In botany, pinnate, with four pairs of leaflets; as a quadrijugous leaf.

inlines.v: QUADRIJU'GOUS, adjective [Latin quadra and jugum, yoke.] In botany, pinnate, with four pairs of leaflets; as a quadrijugous leaf.
